congVote.result: So the motion to instruct conferees on H.R. 3944 was rejected.
congVote.dailyDigestCategory1: Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026_Motion to Instruct Conferees
congVote.dailyDigestSummary: The House failed to agree to the DeLauro motion to instruct conferees on H.R. 3944, making appropriations for military construction, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and related agencies for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, by a yea-and-nay vote of 211 yeas to 213 nays, Roll No. 263. Consideration began yesterday, September 10th.
